summary: Crypto interest product operated by Nexo that became a major U.S. regulatory case in 2023, when Nexo agreed to stop offering its Earn Interest Product to U.S. investors and pay a $45 million settlement while continuing non-U.S. and later restructured operations separately.
what_happened: Nexo offered an Earn Interest Product to customers. In January 2023, the SEC announced that Nexo agreed to cease offering and selling the product to U.S. investors and pay penalties, following Nexo's earlier announcement that it would phase out U.S. products and services. Nexo later returned to the U.S. market with a different structure, so this record tracks the original Earn Interest Product regulatory path rather than a full platform collapse.
uncertainty_notes: This record is product-specific and jurisdiction-specific. It should not be read as a full shutdown of Nexo or as a claim about identical terms across all countries.
notes: Added as event-significant CeFi Earn / interest-account regulatory record.
